source_window.publisher: Exeter City Council via Planning Data

first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public physical building-footprint Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry for The Crawford Hotel, Alphington Road, Exeter. Exeter City Council's authoritative Planning Data entity 7010010043 supplies an explicit Hotel identity and a real MultiPolygon, but the dataset is article-4-direction-area and the published geometry is the Article 4 planning-control area, not a physical building footprint; therefore the footprint acceptance criterion is not satisfied and no individual building record was accepted.
